department: Molecular Biosciences Graduate Program (Beck College of Science and Mathematics)

deadline.value: Application deadline of February 15, 2027 for Fall admission consideration (July 15 for Spring admission).
deadline.quote: by February 15th for consideration for Fall admission and by July 15th for consideration for Spring admission:

gre_general.value: Official GRE Verbal, Quantitative, and Analytical scores are required, with a minimum score of 150 Verbal and 150 Quantitative (300 combined).
gre_general.quote: Scores from the Graduate Record Examination showing a score of 150 on both the verbal and quantitative tests or a combined score of 1000 on the verbal and quantitative sections for scores that used the old scoring system are the minimum requirements.

also.quote: Molecular Biosciences (M.S. & Ph.D) Spring (July 15)/Fall (Feb 15) 2.75 Yes. 300. (Minimum 150 per section)

gre_subject.value: ETS discontinued the GRE Biology Subject Test in May 2021 (Subject Tests remain only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology); A-State's catalog still notes optional advanced subject test scores.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

also.quote: Although not required, scores from an advanced test related to Molecular Biosciences may increase a candidate’s chance for admission.

supervisor.value: Applicants are asked to identify possible faculty research mentors in their statement of research interests; students admitted without a designated Doctoral Advisory Committee chair are assigned an interim adviser for up to one year.
supervisor.quote: Other materials required of MBS applicants are three strong letters of recommendation, a current curriculum vitae and a statement of research interests that includes identification of possible faculty mentors the applicant would like to work with.

funding.value: Graduate Teaching Assistantships and Graduate Research Assistantships are awarded competitively through the Molecular Biosciences Program Committee, and full doctoral graduate assistants receive out-of-state and in-state tuition coverage.
funding.quote: Any university support, whether as a Graduate Teaching Assistant or as a Graduate Research Assistant, will be awarded competitively through the Molecular Biosciences Program Committee.

also.quote: Doctoral graduate assistantship carries a tuition fellowship covering the cost of tuition.

entry_route.value: Minimum of a B.S. in a basic or applied science (preference may be given to M.S.-level applicants); requires at least 72 graduate credits beyond the bachelor's or 45 beyond the master's.
entry_route.quote: Each applicant must have a minimum of a BS in a basic or applied science, although preference may be given to MS level applicants. | A minimum of 72 graduate credits beyond the baccalaureate degree or 45 graduate credits beyond the master’s degree is required.

notes: Cross-disciplinary Ph.D. in Molecular Biosciences integrating molecular, genomic, cellular, and developmental biology, metabolic pathway engineering, bioinformatics, and novel biomaterials; affiliated with the Arkansas Biosciences Institute.
name: Ph.D. in Molecular Biosciences
